subject: maths

concepts.title: Sector of a Circle
concepts.definition: A region of a circle bounded by two radii and the arc connecting their endpoints.
concepts.key_idea: A pie-shaped slice of a circular region.
question_patterns: define a sector
what is a minor sector
identify the major sector in the figure
distinguish between minor and major sectors

solution_steps.explain: A sector is formed by two radii and an arc.

concepts.title: Area of a Sector
concepts.definition: The total surface enclosed within a sector, proportional to the central angle's ratio to 360 degrees.
concepts.key_idea: Sector area is a fraction of the total circle area.
question_patterns: find the area of a sector
calculate the area of a sector with radius {radius} and angle {theta}
what is the area of a sector of angle {theta}
determine the area of the shaded sector

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the circle area by the ratio of the sector angle to 360.

concepts.title: Length of an Arc
concepts.definition: The linear distance along the curved edge of a sector corresponding to a central angle.
concepts.key_idea: Arc length is a fraction of the total circumference.
question_patterns: find the length of the arc
calculate the arc length for a sector of angle {theta}
how long is the arc of a sector with radius {radius}
determine the distance along the curved boundary

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the circumference by the ratio of the angle to 360.

concepts.title: Segment of a Circle
concepts.definition: The region enclosed between a chord and the arc it subtends.
concepts.key_idea: A portion of the circle cut off by a straight line (chord).
question_patterns: what is a segment
define minor and major segments
identify the segment formed by chord AB

solution_steps.explain: A segment is the area between a chord and its corresponding arc.

concepts.title: Area of a Minor Segment
concepts.definition: The area calculated by subtracting the area of the triangle formed by the radii and chord from the area of the sector.
concepts.key_idea: Segment area = Sector area - Triangle area.
question_patterns: find the area of the minor segment
calculate the area of segment APB
what is the area of the segment formed by a chord
determine the area between the chord and the arc

solution_steps.explain: Find the area of the sector using the central angle.
Find the area of the triangle formed by the two radii and the chord.
Subtract the triangle area from the sector area.

concepts.title: Area of Major Sector
concepts.definition: The area of the circle that remains after the minor sector is removed.
concepts.key_idea: Subtract the minor sector from the total circle area.
question_patterns: find the area of the major sector
calculate the area of the corresponding major sector
what is the area of the unshaded sector region

solution_steps.explain: Find the area of the entire circle.
Subtract the minor sector area from the total area.

concepts.title: Area of a Quadrant
concepts.definition: A specific sector of a circle where the central angle is 90 degrees.
concepts.key_idea: A quadrant is one-fourth of a circle.
question_patterns: find the area of a quadrant
calculate the area of a quarter circle
what is the area of a sector with angle 90 degrees

solution_steps.explain: Divide the total circle area by 4.

concepts.title: Area Swept by a Clock Hand
concepts.definition: The sector area covered by the minute hand of a clock over a given duration.
concepts.key_idea: The minute hand sweeps 360 degrees in 60 minutes.
question_patterns: find the area swept by the minute hand in {minutes} minutes
calculate the area covered by a clock hand of length {radius}
how much area does the minute hand sweep

solution_steps.explain: The minute hand moves 6 degrees per minute.
Use the calculated angle to find the area swept.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Find the area of the sector of a circle with radius {radius} cm and of angle {theta}. Also, find the area of the corresponding major sector.

solution_template.explain: Apply the sector area formula for 30 degrees.
Subtract minor area from total circle area.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Find the area of the segment AYB if radius of the circle is {radius} cm and angle AOB = {theta}.

solution_template.explain: Calculate area of triangle OAB using trigonometry or geometry.
Subtract triangle area from sector area.

questions: 1. Find the area of a sector of a circle with radius 6 cm if angle of the sector is 60°.
2. Find the area of a quadrant of a circle whose circumference is 22 cm.
3. The length of the minute hand of a clock is 14 cm. Find the area swept by the minute hand in 5 minutes.
4. A chord of a circle of radius 10 cm subtends a right angle at the centre. Find the area of the corresponding : (i) minor segment (ii) major sector. (Use pi = 3.14)

5. In a circle of radius 21 cm, an arc subtends an angle of 60° at the centre. Find: (i) the length of the arc (ii) area of the sector formed by the arc (iii) area of the segment formed by the corresponding chord
6. A chord of a circle of radius 15 cm subtends an angle of 60° at the centre. Find the areas of the corresponding minor and major segments of the circle. (Use pi = 3.14 and sqrt(3) = 1.73)
7. A chord of a circle of radius 12 cm subtends an angle of 120° at the centre. Find the area of the corresponding segment of the circle. (Use pi = 3.14 and sqrt(3) = 1.73)

8. A horse is tied to a peg at one corner of a square shaped grass field of side 15 m by means of a 5 m long rope. Find (i) the area of that part of the field in which the horse can graze. (ii) the increase in the grazing area if the rope were 10 m long instead of 5 m. (Use pi = 3.14)

9. A brooch is made with silver wire in the form of a circle with diameter 35 mm. The wire is also used in making 5 diameters which divide the circle into 10 equal sectors. Find : (i) the total length of the silver wire required. (ii) the area of each sector of the brooch.
10. An umbrella has 8 ribs which are equally spaced. Assuming umbrella to be a flat circle of radius 45 cm, find the area between the two consecutive ribs of the umbrella.
11. A car has two wipers which do not overlap. Each wiper has a blade of length 25 cm sweeping through an angle of 115°. Find the total area cleaned at each sweep of the blades.

12. To warn ships for underwater rocks, a lighthouse spreads a red coloured light over a sector of angle 80° to a distance of 16.5 km. Find the area of the sea over which the ships are warned. (Use pi = 3.14)
13. A round table cover has six equal designs. If the radius of the cover is 28 cm, find the cost of making the designs at the rate of Rs 0.35 per cm2. (Use sqrt(3) = 1.7)
14. Tick the correct answer: Area of a sector of angle p (in degrees) of a circle with radius R is (D) (p/720) * 2 * pi * R^2
